streamPreview:
I have solid data on OpenClaw from its documentation site. For WorkBuddy, Chinese sites time out consistently from this environment — I'll note the gap explicitly in assumptions.

## comparison

| 维度 | OpenClaw | WorkBuddy |
|---|---|---|
| **定位** | 自托管 AI agent 多消息通道网关 | 基于 Tencent Cloud / CodeBuddy 的工作流/agent 工具 |
| **归属** | OpenClaw Foundation（非营利），MIT 开源，社区驱动 | 腾讯云 / CodeBuddy 产品线，闭源商业产品 |
| **核心能力** | 把 15+ 聊天平台（Telegram、WhatsApp、Discord、Signal、Slack、iMessage、Teams 等）统一接到 AI agent，一条命令安装 Gateway | CodeBuddy（腾讯 AI 编程助手）的扩展/升级版，侧重企业工作流自动化和 agent 编排 |
| **运行方式** | **自托管**：用户自己的机器或服务器上跑一个 Gateway 进程 | **云托管**（推测）：基于腾讯云基础设施，SaaS 模式 |
| **消息通道** | 核心内置 iMessage/Telegram/WebChat；官方插件覆盖 Discord、Feishu、LINE、Matrix、QQ Bot、Signal、WhatsApp、Zalo 等 20+；外部社区插件还有微信等 | 推测主要面向 CodeBuddy IDE 插件 + 腾讯生态（企业微信、飞书等），不是通用多通道网关 |
| **Agent 能力** | 内嵌 agent runtime，支持 tool streaming、multi-agent 路由、隔离 session、35+ 模型提供商（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、vLLM、Ollama 等） | 基于 CodeBuddy 的 AI 编程能力 + 工作流引擎，具体 agent 架构细节未知 |
| **工具生态** | 浏览器自动化、exec、沙箱、web search（10+ 搜索引擎）、cron、skills、plugins、workflow pipeline (Lobster) | 推测包含 workflow 编排、任务自动化，但具体工具列表不详 |
| **界面** | Web Control UI、macOS menu bar app、iOS/Android 节点（Camera、Canvas、Voice） | 推测以 CodeBuddy IDE 插件为主，可能包含 Web 管理面板 |
| **授权模式** | MIT 开源，可自由修改和分发 | 闭源商业产品，按企业订阅 |
| **目标用户** | 开发者 / 极客，希望从手机随时访问个人 AI 助手，数据自控 | 中国企业客户，尤其是腾讯云生态用户，需要企业级工作流自动化 |
| **数据控制** | 数据完全在用户自己的机器上 | 数据在腾讯云，企业需信任云服务商 |
| **部署复杂度** | 需要 Node.js 22+，一条命令安装，5 分钟上线 | 腾讯云账号 + 开通服务，零部署（SaaS） |

**核心差异总结**：OpenClaw 是一个**开源的自托管消息-AGI 网关**，解决的是"我在手机上想跟 AI agent 聊天，但不想把自己的数据交给第三方"；WorkBuddy 是一个**腾讯云生态的企业工作流 agent 工具**，解决的是"在 CodeBuddy 编程助手基础上，怎么让 agent 执行更复杂的业务流程"。两者名字上可能听起来像竞品，实际上解决的问题、架构选择和目标市场差异很大。

---

## verdict

如果你的需求是 **把 agent 接到手机聊天软件，自己管数据，不在乎运维** → OpenClaw 是唯一选择。它是目前市面上最完整的开源多通道 agent 网关，通道覆盖极广，社区活跃，MIT 协议下可以自由改造。

如果你的需求是在 **CodeBuddy 生态内做企业工作流自动化，走腾讯云，需要 SLA 和售后支持** → WorkBuddy 更合适。但要确认它是否真能满足你的业务场景——目前产品信息不够透明，建议申请试用或让腾讯售前做一次深度演示。

**对我（创业公司 CEO，技术背景）的判断**：两个产品解决的是不同问题，不太存在非此即彼的选型。OpenClaw 更像 OMP 的补充或竞品（都是自部署 agent 网关），WorkBuddy 则是腾讯云的商业化工作流工具。如果你已经在用 OMP 管理公司的数字员工，OpenClaw 是值得参考的架构——它的多通道插件体系、沙箱策略、agent 路由模型都有借鉴价值。WorkBuddy 则需要看它能否对接你的具体业务系统再做判断。

---

## open_questions

- WorkBuddy 是否真正做到 multi-agent 路由和隔离 session，还是只是一个工作流编排引擎？
- WorkBuddy 支持哪些消息通道？能否对接钉钉/飞书/企业微信？
- WorkBuddy 是 CodeBuddy 的一个功能模块还是独立产品？
- WorkBuddy 的定价模式是什么（按席位/按调用量/按工作流数）？
- WorkBuddy 是否支持自托管/私有化部署？腾讯云金融/政务专区是否覆盖？
- OpenClaw 的 iOS/Android 节点能力（Camera、Sensor、Canvas）对企业场景有没有实际价值？

## assumptions

- WorkBuddy 是腾讯云/CodeBuddy 旗下的产品，闭源商业（基于 Tencent Cloud techpedia 编号和 codebuddy.cn/work 路径推断）
- WorkBuddy 主要面向中国企业市场（codebuddy.cn 域名 + 中文市场优先）
- WorkBuddy 不支持自托管，走腾讯云 SaaS 模式（基于产品归属推断）
- WorkBuddy 不支持通用多消息通道（基于产品定位和 CodeBuddy 已有的产品形态推断）
- **research_incomplete**: web_search budget 耗尽（3次），WorkBuddy 官网和腾讯云产品页面均无法从当前环境加载，以上分析基于 URL 推断和公共知识，建议补充调研

- claim: OpenClaw 支持 35+ 模型提供商、multi-agent 路由、沙箱、cron、web search 等 | url: https://docs2.openclaw.ai/tools/multi-agent-sandbox-tools | relevance: OpenClaw 官方文档-沙箱和工具策略
- claim: OpenClaw 有 Web Control UI、macOS 应用、iOS/Android 节点 | url: https://docs.openclaw.ai/start/getting-started | relevance: OpenClaw 官方文档-入门指南
- claim: WorkBuddy 关联腾讯云/CodeBuddy 产品线 | url: https://www.tencentcloud.com/techpedia/144114?lang=en | relevance: Tencent Cloud techpedia 条目（无法访问，URL 推断）
- claim: WorkBuddy 中文入口在 codebuddy.cn/work | url: https://www.codebuddy.cn/work/ | relevance: CodeBuddy 官方产品页（无法访问，URL 推断）

Introducing OpenClaw to newcomers title: "OpenClaw" --- # OpenClaw 🦞

> _"EXFOLIATE! EXFOLIATE!"_ — A space lobster, probably

Any OS gateway for AI agents across Discord, Google Chat, iMessage, Matrix, Microsoft Teams, Signal, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, Zalo, and more.
Send a message, get an agent response from your pocket. Run one Gateway across channel plugins, WebChat, and mobile nodes.
Developed in the open by the OpenClaw Foundation, a non-profit.

Install OpenClaw and bring up the Gateway in minutes. Guided setup with `openclaw onboard` and pairing flows. Link Discord, Signal, Telegram, WhatsApp, and more to chat from anywhere. Launch the browser dashboard for chat, config, and sessions. ## Browse docs Mobile browsers may show the section menu without the full desktop tab bar. Use these hub links to reach the same top-level docs areas from the page body. Overview, showcase, first steps, and setup guides. Install paths, updates, containers, hosting, and advanced setup. Messaging channels, pairing, routing, access groups, and channel QA. Architecture, sessions, context, memory, and multi-agent routing. Tools, skills, cron, webhooks, and automation capabilities. Plugin marketplace, publishing, curation, and trust guidance. Providers, model configuration, failover, and local model services. macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, nodes, and web surfaces. Gateway configuration, security, diagnostics, and operations. CLI reference, schemas, RPC, release notes, and templates. Troubleshooting, FAQs, testing, diagnostics, and environment checks. ## What is OpenClaw? OpenClaw is a **self-hosted gateway** that connects your favorite chat apps — Discord, Google Chat, iMessage, Matrix, Microsoft Teams, Signal, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, Zalo, and more via channel plugins — to AI coding agents. You run a single Gateway process on your own machine (or a server), and it becomes the bridge between your messaging apps and an always-available AI assistant. **Who is it for?** Developers and power users who want a personal AI assistant they can message from anywhere — without giving up control of their data or relying on a hosted service. **What makes it different?** - **Self-hosted**: runs on your hardware, your rules - **Multi-channel**: one Gateway serves every configured channel plugin simultaneously - **Agent-native**: built for coding agents with tool use, sessions, memory, and multi-agent routing - **Open source**: MIT licensed, community-driven **What do you need?** Node 24.15+ (recommended), Node 22 LTS (`22.22.3+`) for compatibility, or Node 25.9+, an API key from your chosen provider, and 5 minutes. For best quality and security, use the strongest latest-generation model available. ## How it works ```mermaid flowchart LR A["Chat apps + plugins"] --> B["Gateway"] B --> C["OpenClaw agent"] B --> D["CLI"] B --> E["Web Control UI"] B --> F["macOS app"] B --> G["iOS and Android nodes"] ``` The Gateway is the single source of truth for sessions, routing, and channel connections. ## Key capabilities Discord, iMessage, Signal, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, WebChat, and more with a single Gateway process. Channel plugins add Matrix, Nostr, Twitch, Zalo, and more; official plugins install on demand. Isolated sessions per agent, workspace, or sender. Send and receive images, audio, and documents. Browser dashboard for chat, config, sessions, and nodes. Pair iOS and Android nodes for Canvas, camera, and voice-enabled workflows. ## Quick start ```bash npm install -g openclaw@latest ``` ```bash openclaw onboard --install-daemon ``` Open the Control UI in your browser and send a message: ```bash openclaw dashboard ``` Or connect a channel ([Telegram](/channels/telegram) is fastest) and chat from your phone. Need the full install and dev setup? See [Getting Started](/start/getting-started). ## Dashboard Open the browser Control UI after the Gateway starts. - Local default: [http://127.0.0.1:18789/](http://127.0.0.1:18789/) - Remote access: [Web surfaces](/web) and [Tailscale](/gateway/tailscale)

## Configuration (optional) Config lives at `~/.openclaw/openclaw.json`. - If you **do nothing**, OpenClaw uses the bundled OpenClaw agent runtime; DMs share the agent's main session, and each group chat gets its own session. - If you want to lock it down, start with `channels.whatsapp.allowFrom` and (for groups) mention rules. Example: ```json5 { channels: { whatsapp: { allowFrom: ["+15555550123"], groups: { "*": { requireMention: true } }, }, }, messages: { groupChat: { mentionPatterns: ["@openclaw"] } }, } ``` ## Start here All docs and guides, organized by use case. Core Gateway settings, tokens, and provider config. SSH and tailnet access patterns. Channel-specific setup for Discord, Feishu, Microsoft Teams, Telegram, WhatsApp, and more. iOS and Android nodes with pairing, Canvas, camera, and device actions. Common fixes and troubleshooting entry point. ## Learn more Complete channel, routing, and media capabilities. Workspace isolation and per-agent sessions. Tokens, allowlists, and safety controls. Gateway diagnostics and common errors. Project origins, contributors, and license. `agents.entries.*.tools.sandbox.tools`. `tools.subagents.tools`, if applicable. * Each level can further restrict tools, but cannot grant back denied tools from earlier levels. * If `agents.entries.*.tools.sandbox.tools` is set, it replaces `tools.sandbox.tools` for that agent. * If `agents.entries.*.tools.profile` is set, it overrides `tools.profile` for that agent. * Provider tool keys accept either `provider` (e.g. `google-antigravity`) or `provider/model` (e.g. `openai/gpt-5.4`). This is intentional: an agent configured with a missing tool such as `agents.entries.*.tools.allow: ["query_db"]` should fail loudly until the plugin that registers `query_db` is enabled, not continue as a text-only agent.
